|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Devaronian Uncle]] and the current text; the card was retitled with it (the game text did not change). The original is [[Devaronian Uncle]].
* '''Original''' ([[Devaronian Uncle]]): printed as “•Devaronian Uncle” on the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012), p. 3<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, and listed under that title, with the same text, on the PC website card list from 12 December 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-old-villie">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual Block 8.2 cards are not in the archived Virtual Master list captures (the Virtual Block 8.2 cards first appear in the capture of 12 December 2012)</ref>: “[Pilot] 2. While present at Audience Chamber or stacked on your Objective: non-unique Devaronians are deploy -1, power and forfeit +1, and if Yerka Mig is about to be lost, may place it in Used Pile instead.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the title changed to “•Vilmarh 'Villie' Grahrk”; the game text did not change. The PC website card list shows the new title by 13 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-new-villie">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313222931/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-03-13], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429063548/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-04-29]; VMasterType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314003713/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-03-14], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429102413/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive; these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, PDF page 16)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints the card as •Vilmarh 'Villie' Grahrk.
